experiment_data.hypothesis: Hard filtering (detect-and-remove) at q_score > 0.5 threshold discards contaminated samples and trains uniformly on remaining clean data. Expected to underperform adaptive weighting because it wastes information from borderline samples and the binary threshold is miscalibrated relative to the soft q_score distribution.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/provenance_weight_training && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 WANDB_MODE=disabled python -u training/pretrain_weighted.py --data_path data/scored_data_filtered_q05.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/detect_remove_q05_seed42 --model_name models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --weighting_method uniform --contamination_ratio 0.4 --num_train_tokens 200000000 --batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 --learning_rate 5e-5 --max_length 2048 --seed 42 --save_steps 500 --logging_steps 10 --bf16 --save_total_limit 3"
